user.title: HA AI
user.description: Choose a provider. The API key is checked and the model list is downloaded from the provider, so the next step offers real models as dropdowns. Leave Base URL empty to use the provider preset. Pollinations needs no key and only generates images until a chat model is selected.

data.base_url: Base URL (optional, blank uses the provider preset)

models.title: HA AI models
models.description: Loaded {count} models from the provider. Pick the ones you need; the first entry of each list means "use the provider default" and keeps working if the preset changes.

manual.title: HA AI models (manual)
manual.description: This provider did not return a model catalogue. Type the model ids, or leave them empty to use the provider presets.

error.api_key_required: This provider requires an API key.
error.invalid_auth: The provider rejected this API key.
error.cannot_connect: Could not load the model list from this provider. Check the Base URL and the network, then use the manual form.
error.unknown: Unexpected error while loading the model list.

abort.already_configured: This provider, endpoint and model combination is already configured.

init.title: HA AI options
init.description: Connection settings for {provider}. Saving re-downloads the model list so the next step offers the current models as dropdowns.

data.base_url: Base URL (optional, blank uses the provider preset)
data.llm_hass_api: Home Assistant APIs the agent may use (select 'assist' to control devices)
data.prompt: System prompt (optional, blank uses the Home Assistant default)
